inlines.v: SNA'KY, adjective 1. Pertaining to a snake or to snakes; resembling a snake; serpentine; winding. 2. Sly; cunning; insinuating; deceitful. So to the coast of Jordan he directs his easy steps, girded with snaky wiles. 3. Having serpents; as a snaky rod or want. That sanky headed gorgon shield.
